args.question: Granite Facilities (V-280) has two approved, unpaid invoices: INV-16359 for $1,981.66 (due 2026-11-25) and INV-71145 for $4,663.45 (due 2026-11-04). trace.final:
I paid Granite Facilities' invoice INV-16359 in full by wire from the operating account. The payment went through once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-16359 (vendor V-280), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $1,981.66
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent, and the system confirmed it

Granite Facilities had two approved invoices, so I asked you which one to pay before sending anything. You picked INV-16359. I didn't pay the other one, INV-71145 ($4,663.45, due 2026-11-04), because you said it's under dispute. Before I paid, there were no earlier payments from the operating account, so this isn't a duplicate. I also used a unique key on the wire so a retry can't send it twice. The payment is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
